analysis_type: Analytic ellipsoid support for the native Roszman1 linear-fractional argument b3/(x-b4), followed by arctangent monotonicity, the existing joint-linear support and a conservative intersection with stage 54; no full four-parameter nonlinear optimum or finite bound for fold 5

receipt_gate.stage46: Require status=passed and summarySha256 to match the frozen independent-bounds file
receipt_gate.stage54: Require status=passed and summarySha256 to match the frozen joint-linear-bounds file
receipt_gate.mismatch_policy: Stop before computing any new interval if a receipt, source hash or fold order differs

ratio_rule.ellipsoid: theta=theta_center+delta with delta^T*C^-1*delta<=r^2, r=4; use the full four-parameter covariance
ratio_rule.fixed_x: Let c=b3_center, d0=x-b4_center, a=e3, v=e4, d=d0-v^T*delta and z=(c+a^T*delta)/d
ratio_rule.sign_gate: Require d0+r*sqrt(C44)<0 before solving the ratio; this makes d<0 for every feasible delta. Fold 5 fails this gate and remains unavailable
ratio_rule.support_conditions: For negative d, z>=t iff b3-t*d<=0 for all feasible delta, and z<=t iff b3-t*d>=0 for all feasible delta
ratio_rule.alpha_and_q: alpha(t)=c-t*d0 and q(t)=C33+2*t*C34+t^2*C44. The extrema of b3-t*d are alpha(t)+/-r*sqrt(q(t))
ratio_rule.root_rule: Compute both high-precision roots (B+/-sqrt(B^2-A*D))/A; reject nonpositive A, negative discriminant, zero q or a root that does not satisfy its unsquared support identity
ratio_rule.branch_assignment: Require exactly one lower-support root and one upper-support root, order them, and check the corresponding support sign and nonzero denominator before accepting the ratio interval
ratio_rule.extremizer_witness: At each accepted root evaluate the full four-parameter witness, ellipsoid quadratic form, denominator, ratio and original native prediction. Require quadratic=16, negative denominator and ratio consistent with the corresponding outward-rounded endpoint
ratio_rule.argument_comparison: Retain the stage-46 independent argument interval and require the new ratio interval to lie within it up to the frozen outward-rounding tolerance; do not edit either historical file

known_answer.branch_negative_control: The lower root does not satisfy the upper identity and the upper root does not satisfy the lower identity
known_answer.singular_negative_control: c=1, d0=-1, C33=C44=1, C34=0, r=1 gives A=0 and a crossing denominator, so it must be rejected before root solving

ratio_rule.scope: The ratio component has analytic ellipsoid support at each fixed available x; this is not a Charnes-Cooper or other relaxation and is not a joint optimum of the full native prediction

prediction_rule.linear_support: Reuse the stage-54 exact ellipsoid support for A=b1-b2*x, including its full covariance direction and outward rounding
prediction_rule.ratio_arctangent: Because arctan is increasing, use atan(ratio_min) and atan(ratio_max) with outward rounding
prediction_rule.intersection: Intersect the alternative with the frozen stage-54 final intersection. This also preserves the stage-46 baseline because stage 54 was intersected with it; do not replace either historical baseline
prediction_rule.dependency_scope: The linear support and ratio support are each valid over the same ellipsoid but may be attained at different parameter witnesses. Their sum is conservative and is not a joint full-prediction optimum
prediction_rule.comparison: Record alternative and final widths, ratios and reductions against the stage-54 final intersection; retain every wider alternative, unchanged intersection and empty-intersection failure rather than presuming universal tightening
prediction_rule.point_accounting: Retain 20 available points and all five fold-5 unavailable points. Fold 5 receives no ratio interval, finite prediction bound, extremizer, candidate evaluation or residual upper bound

candidate_rule.support_evaluation: Reuse the 32 frozen stage-54 full-covariance support candidates and their 160 original-model evaluations; do not edit the historical records
candidate_rule.algebraic_extremizers: Add two ratio-extremizer evaluations at each of the 20 available x positions, for 40 additional original-model evaluations
candidate_rule.containment: Every support candidate and algebraic extremizer must lie in the new ratio interval, alternative and final intersection; also retain stage-46 and stage-54 containment checks
candidate_rule.scope: The 200 evaluations are consistency witnesses, not a global optimizer, global optimum proof, probability coverage or independent physical experiment

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic for covariance support, quadratic roots, unsquared branch identities, extremizers and arctangent evaluation
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the frozen 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter conversion to ratio endpoints, arctangent bounds and prediction bounds
numerical_rule.certificate_class: Analytic model-specific support evaluated with high-precision outward-rounded floating-point arithmetic; not an exact rational-algebra certificate or a probability region
numerical_rule.native_crosscheck: Cross-check center and all candidate predictions against the frozen native_model implementation
numerical_rule.empty_intersection: An empty final intersection is a construction failure to report, not a case to hide or repair by changing historical bounds

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1比值分母联合区间_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, covariance matrices, folds, sign certificates, historical results or post-hoc candidate directions
No ratio root solving before the negative denominator sign gate and no finite bound or extremizer for fold 5
No accepting squared roots without the unsquared branch identity and a feasible extremizer witness
No replacing the analytic ratio support with independent numerator/denominator boxes, Charnes-Cooper, Mobius or another unverified relaxation
No calling the separate linear-plus-ratio construction a joint full-prediction global optimum
No hiding wider alternatives, unchanged intersections, unavailable points, branch failures or candidate violations
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage, independent-model-family or independent-experiment claim
No exact rational-certificate claim or replacement of stage-46 or stage-54 baselines
